description: Context7 provides up-to-date, version-specific documentation and code examples for software libraries, designed for use by AI coding agents and developers. It indexes sources such as code repositories, websites, llms.txt files, OpenAPI specs, and Confluence, then serves search and documentation snippets on demand.
summary: Context7 exposes a REST API at `https://context7.com/api`, a public hosted MCP server at `https://mcp.context7.com/mcp`, a separate admin MCP server at `https://admin.mcp.context7.com/mcp`, and the `ctx7` npm CLI; API keys are the main credential, with OAuth also supported for MCP clients.
